architectural_decisions.rationale: The platform is a web service that follows the client-server architecture, where the client makes requests to a server that processes them and returns the response.
To decouple the parts that make up the client-server model, the 3-layer architecture has been used.
For the development of the presentation layer, a logical architecture called Flux has been used.
It has been decided to use NestJS instead of popular alternatives like Express for its opinionated structure that allows creating complex REST APIs.
It has been decided to use TypeORM instead of accessing directly through SQL for its ease of use and its integration with NestJS.
It has been decided to use AWS instead of other alternatives like Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure for its popularity and its low cost.
This separation allows adding security to the system since the only public access is to the business service, which only contains the minimum information to understand the user's requests.
For better response speed of the system, there is a user cache system stored in Amazon DynamoDB, to which the business service has access.
This pattern is found in the Flux architecture, since the store notifies the views when its state changes.
